concepts.title: Painted dungeon
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone landscape game art-direction concept for Dice and Destiny's explorable puzzle-piece roguelike map.
Primary request: A beautiful, readable three-quarter overhead/isometric view of a small irregular board made from 6–9 large, thick, physically interlocking JIGSAW PUZZLE PIECES on a quiet tabletop/void backdrop. These are square-grid jigsaw pieces with large unmistakable rounded knobs and matching sockets, NOT hexagons, NOT ordinary square tiles, NOT scattered islands. Most pieces are already perfectly joined with visible thin jigsaw seams. Their top surfaces depict miniature traversable terrain, rooms, paths and environmental artwork. Paths join at cardinal north/south/east/west edges. Clearly show a central starting crossroads and several branching routes with unexplored empty space beyond exposed puzzle connectors. One original fantasy adventurer MINIATURE stands upright on its own obvious circular beveled display base, which sits ON TOP OF one puzzle tile, like a premium hand-painted tabletop wargaming figure. Figure and round base fit within a tile; leave paths readable. One NEW matching puzzle piece is falling vertically a short distance above the empty eastern grid cell, perfectly aligned to slot into the adjacent tile, with restrained vertical motion streaks, a landing shadow and golden light marking the matching connector. Newly joined nearby seams glow warmly, expressing discovery. All other terrain stays attached and still.
Composition: landscape 3:2; cohesive single scene, generous margin around entire board, board occupies most of image, camera high enough to read routes and jigsaw outlines. Strong silhouette and clear game-scale composition; beautiful terrain detail without obscuring connectors. Cutaway/lowered walls when relevant. Foreground miniature is an exploration pawn, not a life-sized person. Undiscovered tiles are absent or hidden beyond soft fog. No full HUD, labels, typography, watermarks, arrows, collage, multi-panel layout, or licensed character designs.

Art direction for this standalone image:
Style/medium: premium hand-painted tabletop miniature diorama, tactile stone sculpting and tiny brushstroke highlights. Scene: abandoned dungeon with cool slate flagstones, lowered ruined walls, arched doorway, a torchlit room and a branching corridor, a tiny treasure alcove and distant sealed boss door. Tile edges are dark carved stone with large classic puzzle tabs; warm amber torches against cool blue shadows. Hero is an original cloaked sword-and-lantern adventurer on a black round base. The airborne eastern piece is another corridor room. Make this a practical polished 3D game screenshot concept, not a photoreal full-scale building.
